metadata.case_name: LEE LAP PANG v. YUEN TAT WAH T/A CHONG HING MOTOR CO AND ANOTHER

injuries.description: right shoulder pain due to bicept and rotator cuff tendenitis
source: The Plaintiff suffered right shoulder pain due to bicept and rotator cuff tendenitis, and right elbow pain due probably to ulnar neuritis. Dr. Lau assessed him to have suffered 14% permanent disability.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injury of multiple muscles or tendons at shoulder or upper arm level

injuries.description: right elbow pain due probably to ulnar neuritis
source: The Plaintiff suffered right shoulder pain due to bicept and rotator cuff tendenitis, and right elbow pain due probably to ulnar neuritis. Dr. Lau assessed him to have suffered 14% permanent disability.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of ulnar nerve at forearm level

manifestations.description: Numbness over one and half of his fingers when pressure was applied to the right elbow
14% permanent disability (overall assessment by Dr. Lau)

losses.description: Pain, suffering & loss of amenities (general damages awarded as PSLA)
Loss of future earnings due to inability to continue previous work as a welder
Loss of earning capacity (award for diminished ability to find/maintain regular employment)
